emhyr-var-emreis-his-imperial-majesty.nameZh: 恩希尔·瓦·恩瑞斯：皇帝陛下
emhyr-var-emreis-his-imperial-majesty.nameEn: Emhyr var Emreis: His Imperial Majesty
emhyr-var-emreis-his-imperial-majesty.abilityEn: Pick a Torrential Rain card from your deck and play it instantly.
emhyr-var-emreis-his-imperial-majesty.quoteZh: 帕薇塔死时，苍天为之落泪。但不会为我落泪。
emhyr-var-emreis-his-imperial-majesty.quoteEn: "The skies wept when my Pavetta died. They will not weep for me."

emhyr-var-emreis-the-white-flame.nameZh: 恩希尔·瓦·恩瑞斯：白色火焰
emhyr-var-emreis-the-white-flame.nameEn: Emhyr var Emreis: The White Flame
emhyr-var-emreis-the-white-flame.abilityZh: 被动：取消对手的领袖能力。若双方都带此领袖，则双方领袖能力都被取消。
emhyr-var-emreis-the-white-flame.quoteZh: 剑，不过是统治者众多工具中的一件。
emhyr-var-emreis-the-white-flame.quoteEn: "A sword is but one of many tools at a rules's disposal."

eredin-breacc-glas-the-treacherous.nameZh: 埃瑞丁·布莱克·格拉斯：诡诈者
eredin-breacc-glas-the-treacherous.abilityZh: 被动：所有间谍牌战力 ×2（影响双方）。
eredin-breacc-glas-the-treacherous.abilityEn: Doubles the strength of all spy cards (affects both players).
eredin-breacc-glas-the-treacherous.quoteZh: 我很享受。你是我的玩具。
eredin-breacc-glas-the-treacherous.quoteEn: "I'm enjoying this. You are my toy."

eredin-commander-of-the-red-riders.nameEn: Eredin: Commander of the Red Riders
eredin-commander-of-the-red-riders.abilityZh: 己方近战行获得号角效果（该行已有号角则无效）。
eredin-commander-of-the-red-riders.abilityEn: Double the strength of all your Close Combat units (unless a Commander's horn is also present on that row).
eredin-commander-of-the-red-riders.quoteZh: 拿出点尊严来。你知道这会怎么收场。
eredin-commander-of-the-red-riders.quoteEn: "Have some dignity. You know how this will end."

foltest-lord-commander-of-the-north.nameZh: 弗尔泰斯特：北方总指挥官
foltest-lord-commander-of-the-north.nameEn: Foltest: Lord Commander of the North
foltest-lord-commander-of-the-north.abilityZh: 清除当前所有天气效果。
foltest-lord-commander-of-the-north.abilityEn: Clear any weather effects (resulting from Biting Frost, Torrential Rain or Impenetrable Fog cards) in play.
foltest-lord-commander-of-the-north.quoteZh: 去他的谋士和他们的算盘。我只信我士兵的刀锋。
foltest-lord-commander-of-the-north.quoteEn: "Sod advisors and their schemes. I place my trust in my soldiers' blades."

foltest-the-siegemaster.abilityZh: 己方攻城行获得号角效果（该行已有号角则无效）。
foltest-the-siegemaster.abilityEn: Doubles the strength of all your Siege units (unless a Commander's Horn is also present on that row).
foltest-the-siegemaster.quoteZh: 瞄准得好的弩炮，摧毁的不只是敌人的城墙，还有他们的士气。
foltest-the-siegemaster.quoteEn: "A well-aimed ballista razes not just the enemy's walls, but his morale as well."

francesca-findabair-daisy-of-the-valley.nameZh: 法兰茜丝卡·芬达贝：山谷雏菊
francesca-findabair-daisy-of-the-valley.nameEn: Francesca Findabair: Daisy of the Valley
francesca-findabair-daisy-of-the-valley.abilityZh: 被动：开局额外抽 1 张牌。
francesca-findabair-daisy-of-the-valley.abilityEn: Draw an extra card at the beginning of the battle
francesca-findabair-daisy-of-the-valley.quoteZh: 上古种族遗忘的东西，比人类能学会的还多。
francesca-findabair-daisy-of-the-valley.quoteEn: "The Elder Races have forgotten more than humans can ever hope to know."

francesca-findabair-the-beautiful.nameZh: 法兰茜丝卡·芬达贝：美人
francesca-findabair-the-beautiful.abilityZh: 己方远程行获得号角效果（该行已有号角则无效）。
francesca-findabair-the-beautiful.abilityEn: Doubles the strength of all your Ranged Combat units (unless a Commander's Horn is also present on that row).
francesca-findabair-the-beautiful.quoteZh: 别让我的美貌扰乱你的瞄准。
francesca-findabair-the-beautiful.quoteEn: "Do not let my beauty distract your aim."
